method.source_vad: WebRTC VAD mode 3, 30 ms frames, 16 kHz mono PCM, speech regions merged across gaps <=120 ms, measured only inside each English SRT cue window.
method.tts_vad: Each VIV_01 MP3 decoded to 16 kHz mono PCM and measured with the same VAD settings.
method.word_rate: English subtitle token count divided by source VAD active duration.
method.mongolian_syllables: Approximate vowel-nucleus count; heuristic only, not phonetic syllabification.
method.overlap: TTS speech-end offset placed at the English SRT cue start, compared with the next subtitle cue start of any speaker.
limitations: VAD is not phoneme alignment or human listening.
Source music, breaths, effects, and overlapping voices can affect VAD.
Duration ratios are diagnostic only, not direct speed multipliers.
A subtitle-slot overrun is not automatically an audible collision; use actual next dialogue onset and final edit.
No subjective emotion or acting approval is claimed.
